sections.installation:
A) VIA FTP
A download zip archive with AIWU – AI ChatBot, Bulk Content Generator and SEO Tools plugin
Extract files
Copy the folder with the plugin
Open via FTP folder \wp-content\plugins\
Paste plugin folder into here
Go to admin panel => Plugins => AIWU – AI ChatBot, Bulk Content Generator and SEO Tools press activate

B) DIRECT UPLOAD VIA ADMIN AREA
A download zip archive with plugin
Go to admin panel => Plugins => Add new
Choose the archive with a plugin and upload it
Wait until you get the notification installation went successfully
Press Activate button

C) VIA WORDPRESS REPOSITORY
Navigate to admin panel => Plugins => Add new
Type “AIWU – AI ChatBot, Bulk Content Generator and SEO Tools” in the search field
Choose our plugin from the list and click “Install”
Wait until you get the notification installation went successfully
Press Activate button
sections.faq:
What is AIWU and how is it different from ChatGPT or other AI plugins?

AIWU is an all-in-one AI automation plugin for WordPress. It combines content creation, internal linking, WooCommerce automation, and chatbot functionality in one tool — with full support for ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek. Unlike simple prompt tools, AIWU is deeply integrated with your site and gives you control over every AI-generated field, tone, format, and schedule.

Do I need a separate OpenAI or Google API key to use this plugin?

Yes. AIWU does not charge any extra commission or usage fees. You connect your own OpenAI, Gemini, or DeepSeek API key and pay only for what you use — directly to the provider.

What is the AI Chat Bot included in AIWU?

AIWU includes a fully customizable AI Chat Bot for WordPress that works as a 24/7 Live Chat assistant. It can answer questions, guide users, recommend products, and capture leads — all powered by OpenAI, Gemini, or DeepSeek. You can embed it anywhere on your site using a floating widget or shortcode.

Can the AI Chat Bot replace traditional Live Chat support?

Yes. The AI Live Chat in AIWU is designed to handle 80–90% of customer conversations automatically. It understands your business, adapts to your tone, and can escalate to a human agent if needed. It’s a smarter, faster alternative to legacy Live Chat tools.

Is the AI Chat Bot trained on my content?

Yes. You can train the AI Chat Bot on your own content using datasets, fine-tuning, or embeddings (RAG). It can reference your specific products, policies, or brand tone to respond more accurately than a generic chatbot.

Does AIWU work with WooCommerce?

Yes. AIWU includes a WooCommerce Product Fields Generator that lets you generate or rewrite product titles, descriptions, images, tags, reviews, and more — in bulk or individually.

Can I train my own AI model with AIWU?

Yes. You can fine-tune custom models based on your own prompt → completion datasets, and generate embeddings (RAG) using content from your site or files. Your fine-tuned models are then available in any generation scenario inside AIWU.

How does RSS-based blog automation work?

You can connect any RSS feed, and AIWU will turn each item into a unique SEO-optimized article — with proper formatting, keywords, and tone. It can also auto-generate matching social media posts for LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Facebook, and more.

Does the AI ChatBot support live chat with human fallback?

Yes. AIWU’s ChatBot can handle conversations 24/7, but also allows users to request human support when needed. You can configure admin email alerts and customize escalation logic.

Is AIWU compatible with my existing WordPress theme or builder?

Yes. AIWU works out-of-the-box with any theme or page builder. You can use shortcodes or widgets to insert ChatBots, auto-generated posts, and more.

AI Powerhouse for SEO, Traffic & Sales. Includes AI Live Chat, Content & Products Generator, Auto Blog Writer, SEO Auto Linker. (OpenAI, DeepSeek)

The Ultimate AI WordPress Plugin to Skyrocket SEO, Traffic & Sales — All in One Tool

We built AIWU, an all-in-one AI WordPress plugin, to help site owners automate content creation, SEO, and customer interaction — with tools more powerful and flexible than ChatGPT alone.

Includes AI ChatBot ( Live Chat), Bulk Content Generator, RSS-based Auto Blog Writer, WooCommerce Product Fields Generator, Image Generator, SEO Auto Linker, Smart Post Scheduler, and more.

Built on OpenAI (ChatGPT, GPT-4, DALL·E), Google AI (Gemini), and DeepSeek — the most advanced AI engines available today. Use your AI in chats, articles, product pages, and anywhere else content matters.

Start using AI to grow your WordPress site — faster, smarter, fully automated. Install AIWU Plugin now.

Jump to feature:
AI ChatBot | Bulk Content Generator | Blog Automation (via RSS) | WooCommerce AI Editor | Smart Content Crosslinking | Mass Update of Post Fields | Knowledge Base

Features

AI ChatBot with Live Chat & Fine-Tuning

Boost engagement, capture leads, and automate conversations with a fully customizable AI Chat Bot for WordPress.
This smart AI assistant works as a 24/7 AI Live Chat, trained to understand your business, convert visitors, and provide instant support — entirely autonomous, yet allows users to request human assistance when required.

Install in under 10 minutes and unlock powerful tools like AI model fine-tuning, embeddings, real-time analytics, and seamless integration with OpenAI, Gemini, and DeepSeek.
Deploy your AI Chat Bot using a shortcode or floating widget — and control every detail, from design to behavior, access rules, message limits, and human takeover.

Key Features:

  • AI Chat Bot for WordPress that works 24/7 — instantly responds, engages, and converts site visitors.
  • AI Live Chat widget with customizable design, animations, and behavior — perfect for modern WordPress sites.
  • Fully trainable AI assistant — add your own business data, tone of voice, and product knowledge.
  • Multi-provider support — use OpenAI (ChatGPT, GPT-4), Google Gemini, or DeepSeek with your own API key.
  • Contextual memory & smart dialog flow — remembers past messages and keeps conversations natural.
  • Human assistance escalation — let users instantly request to talk to a real person.
  • Role-based access & limits — control how guests, users, and admins interact with the bot.
  • Advanced AI Training — includes fine-tuning, embeddings
  • Embed via shortcode or floating widget — deploy your AI chatbot anywhere on your WordPress site.
  • Real-time analytics & message logging — track user interactions and chatbot performance.

👉 View full AI Chat Bot capabilities

Bulk Content Generator – AI-Powered Article Writing at Scale

Generate 1000+ of SEO-optimized articles in just a few clicks with the Bulk Content Generator from AIWU. Whether you’re building full blogs, product catalogs, glossaries, or topic clusters — you stay in complete control: add unlimited topics and keywords, choose your tone and depth, and launch high-quality content at massive scale. This tool is built for creators, marketers, and businesses that need real results — fast.

User-Friendly, Step-by-Step Workflow — Even for 1,000+ Articles.
No tech skills needed. Just follow the flow and scale your content in minutes:

  1. Enter unlimited topics and keywords. Add as many as you want — perfect for building out full blogs, glossaries, directories, or product catalogs.
  2. Take full control over generation settings. Choose tone, target language, length, apply Human-like writing presets, and add advanced prompts for better precision.
  3. Preview, schedule, or auto-publish. See previews before publishing, get notified when batches are ready — or skip the wait and publish everything automatically.

Flexible Generation of Any Post Fields.
Select which post fields to generate and stay in full control — define the generation mode, add keywords, and apply additional prompts for each.

  • Title: Generate titles based on the article, sections, or use the exact topic value (useful for creating databases, glossaries, directories, etc.).
  • Article Body: Generate the body in one go, by sections (first generate sections and then the body based on them), or custom sections (input exact headings using variables for topics and keywords, applying this structure to thousands of articles. Ideal for databases, glossaries, directories, etc.).
  • Categories and Tags: Specify existing categories or generate a specified number based on the article.
  • Image generator: Over 30+ presets and additional prompts.
  • Alt text generator: Automatically create descriptive, keyword-rich image alt texts based on the article content, section, or focus keyword.
  • Excerpt: Generate SEO-friendly excerpts based on the article.
  • Custom Fields and Taxonomies: Fully compatible with custom taxonomies and fields, allowing the generation of any custom field types.
  • Publication Date: Choose how articles will be published: instantly, scheduled for a specific date, or one per day starting next week? The plugin can handle it all.

Various Generation Modes.
Choose how each article’s body will be generated — even when creating thousands at once:

  • Single-prompt Article: Create WordPress post in one step based on the title.
  • Sectioned Article Generation: Generates the body by first creating an outline and then generating each section individually.
  • Custom Sectioned Article Generation: Manually input an outline using variables like {topic}, {keyword1}, {keyword2}, etc., and generate each section based on this custom outline before combining them into the full body.

Smart Auto Post Scheduler.
Control exactly when and how your articles go live — instantly, on a set date, randomly, or on a consistent schedule (e.g. 1 post per day). Perfect for maintaining a steady publishing rhythm and maximizing SEO and audience reach without manual work.

👉 View full Content Generator capabilities

Bulk Content Generator – AI-Powered Article Writing at Scale

Imagine this… Every day, your WordPress blog publishes fresh, SEO-optimized articles on relevant topics in your industry. Each post includes the right keywords, clean structure, and tone that fits your brand. At the same time, social media posts announcing the article are automatically created for LinkedIn, X, Facebook, and Instagram. Your content ranks high in search, drives organic traffic, and turns traffic into users. No writers. No agencies. No stress.

Your entire content marketing engine runs on autopilot. Sounds like a dream?

Now let us show you how it’s real — with AIWU: Auto Content Creation for WordPress.

How It Works:

  1. Fresh Industry News as a Trigger. Connect any RSS feed — from industry blogs, partners, or news sources.
  2. AIWU Magic with Your Guidance. AI rewrites the content with your brand tone, SEO keywords, and structure using OpenAI, Gemini, or DeepSeek.
  3. Auto Generated Blog Article. A ready-to-publish post is created inside WordPress — title, body, tags, categories, and more.
  4. Social Media Posts About New Articles. Matching posts for social media are generated instantly — and ready to share with your audience.

Key Features:

  • Automatic content generation from any RSS feed — fully AI-powered
  • Original articles created from real industry news — optimized for SEO and your niche
  • Built-in AI rewriting engine using OpenAI, Google Gemini, or DeepSeek
  • Auto blog writer for WordPress — generates full posts with title, body, tags, excerpt, and images
  • AI-powered social media post generator — create matching LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Instagram and Facebook updates
  • Smart filtering and feed management — exclude duplicates, irrelevant topics, or outdated posts
  • Supports multiple feeds — automate content creation from different sources
  • Custom prompts, tone, and structure per feed — personalize every article
  • Auto post scheduler — publish instantly, at specific times, or drip 1 post per day
  • Ideal for WordPress post automation, news sites, niche blogs, affiliate projects, and SEO scaling

Want to automate your entire blog and social media content flow?
Start using AIWU’s WordPress Auto Content Generator today — and let your site grow on autopilot. 👉 Learn more and explore the setup →

WooCommerce Product Fields Generator – AI Bulk Edit for Products

Save hours editing product data manually. With AIWU, you can bulk-generate and bulk-edit product titles, descriptions, images, tags, reviews, and more — directly inside your WooCommerce store.

Perfect for scaling catalogs, refreshing outdated content, or launching new products — without touching a spreadsheet.

Whether you’re managing 10 products or 10,000, AIWU helps you write, rewrite, and enhance product data in bulk — using smart AI prompts, tone controls, and auto keyword insertion. Built for WooCommerce, optimized for SEO, and powered by OpenAI, Gemini, and DeepSeek.

Key Features:

  • Bulk-edit any number of products — instantly
  • Generate missing product content from scratch
  • Rewrite existing product titles and descriptions
  • AI-powered tone control: friendly, professional, technical, or sales-driven
  • Supports bulk updates via filters, categories, or manual selection
  • Smart prompt injection — include keywords, brand terms, or feature lists
  • Customizable output — set length, format, and language
  • Works with OpenAI, Gemini, and DeepSeek APIs
  • Compatible with all product types (simple, variable, virtual, etc.)
  • No CSV imports or external tools needed — works directly in WordPress

Editable Product Fields:

  • Name
  • Description
  • Short Description
  • Category
  • Tags
  • Image
  • Product Reviews
  • Custom Fields

Want to save hours of manual editing and turn your product pages into conversion machines? 👉 Get started with AIWU WooCommerce Product Generator →

AI Smart Content Cross Linking – SEO Auto Linker for Internal Linking at Scale

Automatically enhance your articles with smart, SEO-optimized internal links — at scale. AIWU’s SEO Auto Linker analyzes each post and inserts AI-generated contextual paragraphs with links to relevant content. This means stronger internal linking, better SEO performance, and more user engagement — without touching a single post manually.

Perfect for large content libraries, affiliate sites, and any blog that needs structured, keyword-driven internal SEO.

Key Features:

  • Bulk internal linking — update dozens or hundreds of posts in one click
  • Contextual paragraphs, Not Just Links. AI generates relevant AI-written paragraphs with embedded internal or external links instead of just inserting links randomly
  • Context-aware link placement — AI scans each post and finds the best insertion point
  • Choose how many links should be added per article
  • SEO Auto Linker works with your keywords, linking rules, and brand tone
  • Improves topical authority, SEO clusters, and on-site navigation
  • Automation with full control — preview, review, or publish instantly

Scale your internal linking and SEO without manual effort. 👉 Explore Smart Content Crosslinking →

Mass Update of WordPress Post Fields – AI Posts Bulk Editor

Save time by updating hundreds of existing posts with AI — instantly. With AIWU’s Bulk Post Field Generator, you can rewrite or fill in missing content across multiple articles: titles, excerpts, meta descriptions, tags, images, alt text and more. Perfect for refreshing old posts, fixing SEO gaps, or bulk-optimizing imported content.

Key Features:

  • Bulk edit existing posts with AI
  • Choose which fields to update: title, excerpt, image, alt text, categories, tags, custom fields, etc.
  • Filter posts by category, keyword, or post type
  • Set tone, language, length, and apply Human-like writing presets
  • Preview or publish instantly — full control at every step

👉 Learn more and start bulk editing your content →

AI Image Generator – Create Beautiful Images Automatically

Bring your content to life with AI-generated images — available across all AIWU modules. Whether you’re creating articles, product pages, or blog clusters, you can instantly generate unique visuals using 30+ AI styles, custom prompts, and auto-generated ALT texts for SEO.

No stock photos. No manual uploads. Just relevant, AI-generated images that match your content and brand voice — on demand.

AI Providers & API Settings – Full Control, No Extra Fees

AIWU connects directly to your own API keys — with no extra fees, no usage limits from us, and no hidden charges. You stay in full control of your AI costs and model selection, using the most advanced LLMs available.

  • OpenAI. Fully supports ChatGPT, including all models: GPT-4, GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4.5, GPT-3.5, and more.
  • Google AI. Powered by Gemini – optimized for reasoning, language understanding, and long-form generation
  • DeepSeek. Lightweight, high-performance open model — ideal for fast generation tasks

Advanced API Configuration:

  • Language — set output language per project or field (200+ languages)
  • Tone of voice — formal, friendly, professional, technical, etc. (30+ presets)
  • Temperature — control creativity and randomness
  • Top P — adjust token sampling diversity
  • Max tokens — limit the length of the response
  • Requests per minute — set rate limits per provider
  • Frequency penalty — reduce repetition
  • Presence penalty — encourage topic diversity

Scenarios — Full Control Over All AI Operations

View, edit, and manage every AI-powered action in one place. Track usage, monitor token spend, and control the status of generated content — from bulk posts to chatbots.

Proven Results – What Happens After Using AIWU

After 6 months of using AIWU, users report:

  • 1000% growth in organic traffic. Experience explosive growth in visibility, keyword rankings, and long-term search traffic.
  • 65% increase in organic users. Attract more relevant, engaged visitors ready to convert.
  • 10x reduction in content costs. Cut expenses without sacrificing quality — create better, faster, smarter with AI.
  • Up to 4x increase in conversions from AI ChatBot. Automate lead capture and support with a 24/7 AI assistant that converts visitors into customers — instantly and at scale.

Real results. Real growth. All starting from a single plugin.
